sentences.text:
Shri Daya Ram Sharma- Advocate for the appellant.
 Shri Ajay Kumar Nirankari- Public Prosecutor for respond IA No.22780/2023 first application under Section 389 of Cr.P.C. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of appellant-Brajesh Rajput.

T he appellant has been convicted under Sections 450, 376(D), 506(2) IPC and sentenced to undergo RI For five years with a fine of Rs.2,000/-; RI for twenty years with a fine of Rs.5,000/-;
and RI for three years with default stipulations vide judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 16.07.2022 passed by VI Additional Sessions Judge, Gwalior (M.P.) in Sessions Trial No.196 of 2017.
All the sentences have been directed to run concurrently.
As per prosecution case, on 04.02.2017, all the accused including present appellant entered into the house of the prosectrix and committed rape one by one.
On hearing screams, her uncle who was sleeping on the roof woke up and got them run away by pelting stones.
Next day, FIR was lodged and the prosecutrix was medically examined by the doctor.
Her clothes were recovered on which male sperms were found.
Though all the accused including present appellant took plea of alibi, they could not establish it.
However, the prosecutrix was also found pregnant later.

In view of aforesaid, we are not inclined to allow this application filed under Section 389 Cr.P.C.
2 CRA-7148-2022 Accordingly, IA No.22780/2023 stands rejected.
List along with Criminal Appeal No.6913 of 2022.
